static_traits.name: Lin Jie
static_traits.social_status: has spouse and children's support, but not comfortable discussing certain feelings or situations with family
static_traits.language_features: clear expression, fairly good logic, highly cooperative, capable of self-Reflection; steady tone but visibly tense, prone to catastrophizing and negativity under stress

basic_info.main_problem: the client feels unsafe and is always hungry; also, believing ambitions ruined after crashing the self-purchased Corvette, these situations cause Increased stress and negative emotions.
basic_info.core_demands: The client decided to seek counseling because these problems have affected their mental health and daily life (work and family interaction); and expressed willingness to try practicing in order to feel better.

core_beliefs: one mistake means I can never achieve anything again
good things will never happen to me again

special_situations.event: unable to focus at Work, repeatedly thinking of the Corvette crash
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: if I make a major mistake, it equals complete failure, and no good things will happen in the future either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: easing discomfort by eating more, and trying to avoid thinking about the accident
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I can never achieve anything again; I can never do anything well again

special_situations.event: When recalling the Corvette accident alone, stress rises markedly
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the symbol of my dream is destroyed, my ambitions are completely destroyed along with it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding talking about or thinking of the accident
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: All my efforts and ambitions have come to nothing

special_situations.event: daily insecurity and persistent hunger, especially under high pressure
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: when stress appears, it means I cannot control or cope
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Eating more to seek short-term comfort
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot hold on, I have no ability to handle this stress

core_conflict.wish: Longs to maintain achievement and self-worth, and to be recognized and supported in work and family roles
core_conflict.fear: fear that one serious mistake will lead to being negated, the future completely ruined, and losing control over Work and family
defense_goal: reducing anxiety and maintaining fragile self-esteem through avoidance (not thinking about the accident) and self-soothing (eating)

object_relations.object_representation: Harsh others / a world that may disappoint

manifestations: after crashing the Corvette symbolizing dreams, feeling ambitions ruined, losing hope for the future
worsening insecurity and negative thinking in high-pressure situations

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the energy originally wanting to be sent outward and instead directs it at themselves or does it themselves to relieve it, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: easing tension and unease by eating more
unwilling to discuss certain feelings or situations with family, processing emotions inwardly

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: avoiding thinking or talking about the accident to escape direct triggers of negative emotions

exception_events.target_problem: when Making mistakes at work or thinking of the accident, the client usually catastrophically believes oneself a complete failure, with Persistent anxiety and Decreased attention.
exception_events.unique_outcome: past mistakes at Work, but the client managed to fix the problem and subsequently Gaining recognition, not yet defined by one setback.
exception_events.reason: different understanding and approach: treating mistakes as fixable setbacks and taking concrete improvement actions; keeping past success experiences as evidence, thus softening catastrophic conclusions.

positive_force: having experiences of fixing mistakes and Gaining recognition, showing problem-solving ability and resilience
Willingness to actively seek counseling and cooperate with exercises
having basic family support (spouse and children)
negative_force: poor cognitive patterns of catastrophizing, overgeneralization, mental filtering, negating the positive and predicting the future
Excessive working hours leading to stress buildup
persistent insecurity and tension, short-term coping mainly of eating and avoidant thinking
Under stress, tends to ignore positive evidence and focus on negative outcomes

target_behavior.behavior: catastrophic and overgeneralized negative thinking (e.g. 'I can never achieve anything again')
antecedent: Thinking of the Corvette crash or recalling the accident
Encountering pressure or mistakes at work
target_behavior.core_reason: Equates one accident with total failure, ignoring past experiences of success and error correction
target_behavior.function: escaping uncertainty and failure feelings, gaining brief 'certainty' through negative conclusions and reducing present anxiety
target_behavior.consequence: worsening stress and negative emotions,Decreased attention, Work and family life affected

target_behavior.behavior: Increased eating as a coping response
antecedent: during high pressure or Low mood
when thinking of the accident or feeling insecure
target_behavior.core_reason: seeking immediate physical and psychological comfort to ease tension and unease
target_behavior.function: self-soothing and negative Reinforcement (temporarily reducing anxiety)
target_behavior.consequence: temporary relief but unable to solve the root problem, possibly further Reinforcing the avoidance and stress cycle

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding thinking about or discussing the accident
antecedent: When someone mentions vehicle- or accident-related cues
moments of associating Being alone with the accident
target_behavior.core_reason: worrying about re-triggering despair and failure feelings
target_behavior.function: escaping painful stimuli to reduce immediate discomfort
target_behavior.consequence: Maintains and deepens negative beliefs and emotions; the problem persists
